methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-15. Directly fetched and confirmed: coinledger.io/pricing, zenledger.io/pricing, blockpit.io/pricing. Koinly, CoinTracker, TokenTax, Summ, and Awaken official pricing pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so pricing was corroborated across multiple independent 2026 review sources and vendor help centers (Koinly help center, milkroad, comparedge, findstack, cryptopotato, cryptoadventure, fortunly, finder, banksforcrypto, bitdegree) and official summ.com blog/snippets. Corrections vs draft: Koinly Trader is 3,000 tx (not 10,000); Koinly's $279 tier is named Pro for 10,000 tx (the draft's 'Oracle'/25,000-tx plan does not exist and was removed). CoinTracker Base is $59/yr (not $29); the draft's Base+ and Prime+ tiers could not be verified on current sources and were removed in favor of the structure shown by comparedge (Base/Prime/Ultra/Ultra+/Full Service). All crypto-tax plans are priced per tax year by transaction-count tier; monthlyUsd holds the published annual plan price as a flat number, billingModel 'flat'. Summ is the exception: limits are cumulative across ALL financial years and the subscription is per calendar year. Blockpit publishes EUR only, so monthlyUsd is null for its paid tiers. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Koinly
vendors.provenance: koinly.io/pricing direct fetch returned 403. Plan structure confirmed via Koinly help center (support.koinly.io) and multiple 2026 reviews (findstack, cryptoadventure, cryptopotato, innovatehubfinance, milkroad). Confirmed five tiers: Free, Newbie $49/100tx, Hodler $99/1000tx, Trader $179/3000tx, Pro $279/10000tx. The draft's 'Oracle $279/25000tx' plan does not exist (removed); the $279 tier is named Pro and covers 10,000 tx. Trader covers 3,000 tx, not 10,000.

plans.notes: Per tax year, up to 3,000 transactions (corrected from draft's 10,000). Adds expert email support. Some 2026 review sources list $199 for this tier; findstack (mirroring the official page) shows $179.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per tax year, up to 10,000 transactions (corrected: draft called this 'Oracle' at 25,000 tx, which does not exist). Highest self-serve tier; additional transactions purchasable above 10,000.

limits: Free plan: portfolio + preview only, no downloadable tax reports
keyFeatures: 800+ exchange integrations and broad DeFi protocol coverage
